Join us on our mission to make a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day. Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company. For more information visit cultureamp.com . How you can help make a better world of work Culture Amp is looking for an exceptional Senior Account Executive to join our Commercial (Mid-Market) Sales team. In this role, you ll be at the forefront of Culture Amp s growth in the commercial segment (up to 1,000 users), hunting new logos and helping ambitious organisations build a better world of work for their people. You ll bring a consultative, insight-led approach to fast-moving, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. You ll partner closely with SDRs and Marketing to build pipeline and deliver a differentiated experience for commercial buyers, connecting their people challenges to measurable business outcomes. If you re deeply curious, commercially sharp, and energised by the challenge of winning in a competitive market, you re what we call a #peoplegeek and this role was built for you. You will Drive new logo acquisition across your commercial territory, owning the full sales cycle from outbound prospecting through to close. Generate a significant portion of your own pipeline through proactive outbounding, using a combination of tools, tactics, and sales methodologies to break into target accounts. Build and manage a robust, accurately forecasted pipeline in Salesforce, maintaining consistent pipeline hygiene and weekly forecast updates. Run tailored product demonstrations and business case presentations for People Leaders and key stakeholders, clearly articulating Culture Amp s competitive differentiators and ROI. Build multi-threaded relationships across HR and key decision makers to drive consensus and accelerate deal velocity. Collaborate cross-functionally with SDRs, Marketing, and RevOps to deliver a seamless, high-quality experience for prospects. Contribute to the broader Commercial team s craft, sharing learnings, participating in deal clinics, and helping raise the bar on how we sell. You have 3+ years of proven sales experience in a closing role, with a focus on new business acquisition. A proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota and experience managing multi-stakeholder deals. Strong outbound and self-sourcing capability, with experience building pipeline from scratch rather than relying on inbound and SDR channels alone. Solid sales craft: territory and account planning, stakeholder engagement, value/ROI-based selling, and the ability to navigate commercial negotiations. Experience selling to HR, People and Culture, or business leaders and the ability to connect business initiatives to measurable outcomes. Proficiency in Salesforce and core GTM tools (e.g. Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach); formal sales methodology training (e.g. MEDDPICC, Challenger, Sandler) is a strong plus. Experience in HR tech, HCM, or adjacent SaaS is advantageous but not required. You are Resilient. Role Purpose The Director, Customer Success (internally we call it Customer Experience (CX)) Pod Leader is accountable for driving customer value, retention, and expansion across a shared book of business within a cross-functional pod. This role leads a team of Customer Success Managers and Renewals Managers with the same rigor, commercial edge, and coaching intensity expected of a senior CS leader ; while operating as an equal partner to the Director, Sales in building one unified GTM engine. Duties Responsibilities CX Practice Leadership Own the pod s renewal forecast and maintain forecast integrity, speak to week-over-week movement, and translate CSM inputs and your own book inspection into a dependable, consistent number that leadership can rely on. Lead pod territory design within your book of business. Working with your Sales Pod Leader and RevOps, translate the pod s assigned accounts into clearly defined CSM and RM territories that optimize for coverage, collaboration, and customer continuity. Diagnose and manage portfolio health through monitoring adoption trends, engagement signals, and risk indicators using Vitally, Salesforce, and Gong; ensuring a no-surprises renewal motion through early identification, strong value realization and proactive mitigation of at-risk accounts. Lead renewals process discipline and set strategy for renewal negotiations, manage commercial timelines, and hold the team accountable for securing outcomes well ahead of renewal dates; own GRR as a personal accountability. Coach CSMs and Renewals Managers into strategic advisors to develop the team through a consistent operating rhythm of 1:1s, performance coaching, feedback, and career development conversations that build capability and drive accountability. Serve as executive sponsor on high-stakes accounts and act as the senior CX point of contact for complex escalations, expectation resets, and moments where the partnership with the customer is at risk. Drive adoption goal-setting and outcome delivery to set adoption goals across the pod s book, hold the team accountable to specific account plans, and move the team from reactive firefighting to proactive customer engagement. Manage team performance rigorously and lead them through structured performance management, ensure high standards are celebrated and gaps are addressed, and contribute to hiring and onboarding decisions that raise the bar of the team. Shared Pod Responsibilities (co-owned with the Director, Sales) Own the customer lifecycle as a shared responsibility and partner closely with the Sales Pod Leader to ensure seamless handoffs, no gaps in customer coverage, and a joined-up experience from acquisition through adoption, renewal, and expansion. jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Commercial
jobs.desc: We’re big believers in the power of IRL, so for most roles we ask Campers to work from their local Culture Amp office an average of 2 days a week to unlock connection, pace and culture together. Join us on our mission to make a better world of work. Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day. Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company. For more information visit cultureamp.com . How you can help make a better world of work We’re looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to partner with our Named Commercial (Mid‑Market) customers to drive adoption, retention, and expansion outcomes across Culture Amp’s Employee Experience and Performance platform. You’ll be the strategic, post‑sale partner to People Culture leaders, building success plans, leading executive strategy reviews, and translating people science insights into action. This role manages a broad book of business, collaborates very closely within our pod - model that includes Account Management, Renewals, and Account Executives. Other collaborators include People Science, Customer Trainers, Implementation, and Support. This role advocates for the customer voice to influence our roadmap. You’ll thrive here if you’re deeply curious, customer first, and outcomes focused. Responsibilities: Own a book of primarily Named Commercial (Mid‑Market ~400 -1,000 employees) customers and are accountable for exceeding quarterly Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and growth targets. Build Success Plans, and drive QBRs with HR leaders (CPOs/CHROs), aligning platform use to business and people goals. Proactively drive adoption by monitoring product usage and health to identify risks and expansion opportunities; create and execute mitigation and growth plans in partnership with Account Management and Renewals. Enable customers on Culture Amp and the broader people culture domain; deliver strategic guidance that accelerates adoption and value realization for customers tied to their business goals. Coordinate and support the right internal experts at the right moments; ensure seamless handoffs from/to sales customer experience to deliver against customer objectives. Leverage AI-driven tools (e.g., Gemini, Gong, Glean) to synthesize customer insights, refine strategic communication, and proactively identify signals that drive better customer outcomes Document key moments and decisions in our system of record (e.g., Vitally/Salesforce), track value and renewal progress, and communicate clearly and often. Coach customers through challenging conversations, set realistic expectations, and resolve escalations in partnership with internal leaders. Advocate for customers internally by sharing insights and structured feedback to Product and Engineering to improve experience and outcomes. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across CS both at the region and global level; sharing playbooks, insights, and scalable practices with the team. After 3 months in this role you’ll: Confidently run customer kick‑offs, QBRs , project meetings, risk mitigation plans; support renewal and expansion motions in collaboration with account managers and renewals to influence GRR and growth goals. Demonstrate working fluency in Culture Amp’s core products (Engagement, Performance, Development AI Coach) and common Mid‑Market use cases.

jobs.title: Senior People Science Analyst (12 month FTC)
jobs.desc: We’re big believers in the power of IRL, so for most roles we ask Campers to work from their local Culture Amp office an average of 2 days a week to unlock connection, pace and culture together. Join us on our mission to make a better world of work. Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day. Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company. For more information visit cultureamp.com . We re looking for a Senior People Science Analyst to join our global People Science Analytics team on a 12-month fixed term contract. You ll specifically partner with customers across EMEA and North America on bespoke research using Culture Amp and customer-supplied data, owning studies from question through to action. GenAI tools will be part of that workflow, helping you work more efficiently, as you continue to identify further areas for improvement. As a thought leader in HR analytics, you ll combine data across diverse customers and use methods from psychology, economics and business to generate advanced insights into how employee experience shapes outcomes like turnover, sales performance and customer satisfaction. You ll surface trends for the HR community and make complex findings accessible through clear, engaging stories and practical strategies. The work is technical and customer-facing. You ll listen closely to customers, bring clarity to methodology and reporting, and collaborate with HR leaders, customer-facing People Scientists, Customer Success Managers and Account Managers to develop studies and insight reports for clients and the wider public. You ll also help customers and colleagues build confidence with data. Because the team is small and the projects are complex, you ll have real ownership over which questions are worth answering and how they get answered. As part of this team of amazing humans, You will: Lead customer discovery and own studies end to end, from clarifying the business problem and shaping the research question through to design, delivery and recommendations Design, clean, combine and explore platform and customer-supplied datasets using robust, reusable approaches that protect participant privacy Conduct rigorous statistical analyses across engagement, lifecycle, performance and team effectiveness data, generating actionable and, where appropriate, predictive insights tied to business outcomes Use AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, synthesis and communication, while validating outputs, protecting customer data and maintaining methodological rigour Collaborate with customer-facing People Scientists on advanced HR analytics projects, applying sound judgment about methods, limitations and trade-offs Identify the themes and stories most likely to help organisations improve their culture and business outcomes, then communicate them through clear reports, presentations and internal and external thought leadership Create reusable methods, templates and assets; improve internal processes and practices; and negotiate scope, priorities and timelines to deliver high-quality work You have: An advanced degree (Masters or PhD) in organisational psychology, quantitative social science, economics or a related field, or equivalent applied research experience Applied experience using quantitative research methods on people or workforce data, ideal
